Commentary.Commentary: So, that’s it from this game! The third T20I is a must-win for the Aussies if they are to stay alive in the series. Whereas a win for the Windies will see them win the series. All to play for. That game is on the 13th of July and it begins at 1930 local (2330 GMT). Till then, take care and goodbye!

Nicholas Pooran, Windies skipper, starts by thanking his coach and his team for giving him the opportunity to captain the side. Mentions they were going to bat first even if they batted first, they promoted Dwayne Bravo to keep the left-hand right-hand combination and it worked. Informs it was Dwayne’s idea and then they took the advice of Kieron Pollard and went ahead with it. Adds Fabian Allen is very good and they are just sticking to the team plan which is very pleasing.

Aaron Finch, Australian skipper, says the wicket did not change a lot but they needed to get off to a good start but they could not and that put a lot of pressure on an inexperienced middle order. States the first half was good but the last 10 is where the game slipped away, it was not easy with a left and right-hand combination and they will reflect on this. Ends by saying they will work hard and try to comeback stronger.

Shimron Hetmyer, Man of the Match, says this was one of his best T20 innings, he paced his innings well, he enjoyed the role of taking it deep and he thanks the team for giving him that role. States he wasn’t doing anything different in this game, he just wanted to be there and accelerate towards the end. Adds he is trying to learn how to bat deep and also finish the innings well. Mentions he enjoyed batting with Dwayne Bravo who he batted with for the first time and he kept talking to him.

Earlier in the day, after being inserted, Windies were in a spot of bother at the end of the 10th over. Shimron Hetmyer and Dwayne Bravo though added 100-plus with Hetmyer scoring a half ton laid the foundation and Andre Russell with some meaty blows took the Windie to just under 200 which they easily defended.

For the Windies, everybody except for Fabian Allen and Lendl Simmons who bowled just the one ball had a wicket to his name. Allen though was brilliant as he only went for 22 in his four. It was him who built the pressure and the rest reaped the rewards. Over, it was quite a professional bowling performance from them.

A clinical win for Windies and they have taken a 2-0 lead in this series. 197 was always going to be a tough chase and it got even tougher when Aaron Finch and Matthew Wade were dismissed in the Powerplay. Mitchell Marsh along with Moises Henriques and Josh Philippe did steady things. Marsh scored yet another half ton but departed when it was time for him to step on the gas. Once he fell, it all fell apart for the visitors as they kept losing wickets and eventually fell way short of the total.
OUT! BOWLED! That's it, West Indies win by 56 runs! A short ball, angling in on middle. Josh Hazlewood looks to heave it without any feet movement. The ball goes through and hits the stumps.
On middle. Eased down to long on for one.
FOUR! A fuller ball, around middle. Josh Hazlewood looks to drive but gets a thick outside edge towards third man for a boundary.
WIDE! Bowls a pacy short ball, on middle. Josh Hazlewood looks to ramp it but misses it. Wided.
OUT! CAUGHT! Sheldon Cottrell gets his second wicket! A length ball, slanting across, outside off. Zampa drives it uppishly straight in the hands of Akeal Hosein(sub) as he takes the catch with ease.
Commentary.Howout: c sub Akeal Hosein b Sheldon Cottrell

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller ball, on off. Driven to covers for a single.
A slower length ball, on middle. Zampa splices it to vacant mid-wicket region for a single.
A fuller ball, on off. Starc hammers it straight back to the bowler, who half-stops it and deflects it to long on for one run.
A short ball, on middle. Starc pulls it straight to mid-wicket.
Fuller and on off, this is hit down to long off for a single.
A low full toss outside off, this is carved through point for two.
WIDE! Well wide outside off, Starc fails to jam it out.
On middle, this is heaved through mid-wicket for one.
On middle, Starc hits it down to long off for one.
A slower one on off, it is hit down to long off for one.
OUT! TIMBER! Christian falls now! He steps out and Bravo bowls it on the pads, giving no room to the batter. Christian swings but misses. It hits the pad and hits the stumps.
A full toss on the pads, Christian works it through square leg for another run.

NOT OUT! Christian is well in! Not sure why that was taken upstairs. Good work from Fletcher though. This is full and on off, this is jammed through mid-wicket. They go for the second. Fletcher hits the stumps at the keeper's end. It is referred upstairs. Replays show that Christian is well in.
Direct hit and it is taken upstairs! Christian seems in.
A quick bumper now on the body, Christian evades it.
FOUR! Powered! Full and on middle, right in the slot. This is smashed down the ground to the long on fence.
Now Christian moves right across to the off side and Russell bowls it just outside off. Christian swings but misses again.
WIDE! Yet another wide as this is also bowled well outside off. Left alone.
WIDE! Well wide outside off, left alone.
A yorker outside off, Dan looks to play the sweep on the leg side but misses.
Another single as this is pushed through mid on for one.
On middle, this is lofted down the ground towards long off for one.

OUT! IT IS AGAR WHO HAS TO WALK BACK! Both were in the crease when the bails were broken but it was Christian who came in first. However, a wicket has been lost and it is all falling apart a little too quickly for the Aussies now. This is shorter and on middle, it is pulled towards mid-wicket. Christian wants a run but Agar is not interested. Simmons picks the ball up and throws it to the keeper who whips the bails easily. Both the batters are stranded at one end. It is taken upstairs to check who has to walk back. Replays show that both are in the crease but it is Christian who made it in first.
Somebody is out for sure but who? They have taken it upstairs to check.
On middle, eased down to long on for one.
Ashton Agar walks out to bat!

OUT! CAUGHT! Australia are falling like a pack of cards! Bowls a slow, loopy ball, on middle. Moises Henriques gets on knee and slogs it towards deep mid-wicket, straight in the hands of the stationed Fabian Allen at the deep.
Commentary.Howout: c Fabian Allen b Hayden Walsh

Commentary.Commentary: A loopy ball, around off. Dan Christian steps down the track and eases it to long on for one.

OUT! TAKEN! McDermott holes out! This is full and on off, Ben fails to get under it. It was way too full to get the deseried elevation. He ends up hitting it towards long on where Bravo takes it. The game now slipping away from the Aussies.
Commentary.Howout: c Dwayne Bravo b Andre Russell

Commentary.Commentary: Brilliant stuff from Russell! He once again bowls it well wide outside off, to his field. It is carved towards deep point for one.
Just the single again! Singles won't do it for the Aussies! Outside off, this is carved towards deep point for one.
Just another single! Full and outside off, Henriques squeezes it out towards third man for one.
Just the one! Another yorker outside off, this is jammed out towards cover for one.
A dot! Australia can't offord those right now. A yorker outside off. Ben McDermott fails to put bat on ball.
Andre Russell is back!
Googly, around off. Ben McDermott taps it to point for one. Australia need 90 off 36 balls.
FOUR! A freebie and that is dispatched for a boundary! A slower ball, on middle. Ben McDermott rocks back and pulls it away into the gap between mid-wicket and long on for a boundary.
Around off, pushed to covers for a single.
This is brilliant bowling by Hayden Walsh! Bowls a slower loopy ball, outside off. Moises Henriques looks to pull but misses it.

OUT! CAUGHT! Dwayne Bravo with a stunner at long off! Big wicket for West Indies! A slower short ball, on leg. Marsh rocks back and looks to slash it over long off. Dwayne Bravo at the deep times his jump perfectly and takes a stunner to dismiss Mitchell Marsh, as he walks back after a well-made 54.
Commentary.Howout: c Dwayne Bravo b Hayden Walsh

Commentary.Commentary: A slower loopy ball, around leg. Marsh misses his pull as he gets beaten by the pace.

That is brilliant from Russell! He has saved five runs for his side! On middle, this is fuller. Marsh just about gets under that one and lifts it towards long on. Russell there, takes it but then realizes he is going over so throws it back into play. Just the single.
On off, this is pushed down to long off for one.

Dropped! Harsh to call that one a drop but it is one! This is very full and on middle, it is smashed back towards the bowler. Allen fails to react in time. It hits his hand and goes behind for one. That needed to stick.
Now fires it full and outside off, Henriques looks to play the slog sweep again but misses. It hits the pad and rolls towards short third man for a leg bye.
Lovely! Varying his pace brilliantly! Slows it up and lands it outside off. Henriques looks to play the slog sweep but misses.
Fires in a low full toss outside off, it is hit down to long off only for one.
Length ball, outside off. Pushed to the off side for a single.
WIDE! Spills it way down the leg side, Marsh misses his nudge. Wided.
FOUR! 50 up for Mitchell Marsh! Consecutive half-centuries for him! Continues his fine form! Around off, driven through covers for a boundary.
Another slower dipping low full toss, on middle. Marsh works it to long on for a couple of runs.
Slower ball, on off. Moises Henriques drives it to long off for one.
Another slower length ball, on off, pushed to covers for a single.
A low dipping full toss, on middle. Eased down to long on for a quick couple.
On middle, worked towards long on for one. 113 runs required off 54 balls.
Again a fuller length, on off. Eased down to long on for one run.
Fuller ball, on off. Driven to long off for a single.
Darted on the pads, flicked to mid-wicket for one.

DROPPED! Dwayne Bravo the culprit this time! Tosses it up, outside off. Moises Henriques looks to paddle but gets a thick outside edge, in the air and towards short third man. Dwayne Bravo there, runs to his right, gets underneath but spills it out. Two taken.
Tossed up, outside off. Moises Henriques misses his paddle sweep.
Outside off, this is guided towards short third man for another run.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through square leg for one.
WIDE! Slower through the air but well wide outside off. Left alone.
Brilliant from Hetmyer! Full and on off, this is driven towards cover. The fielder dives to his right and saves a run for his side.
A single now as this is worked through square leg.
SIX! Over the fence. Excellent use of the feet. Comes down the track, gets to the pitch of it and lofts it well over the long off fence.

Was that a chance? This is shorter and outside off, it is cut to short third man. The batters go for one. Marsh is late to take off. The throw is to the bowler who does not take the bails off in the first attempt. Would have been touch and go.
So despite the boundary on the first ball, only 8 from the over. Full and on off, it is jammed down the ground towards long off for one.
Just another single! On the pads, Henriques looks to flick, he misses, it hits the pad and goes towards fine leg for one. Leg bye!
Flatter and on off, Henriques pushes it to covers.
Fuller and outside off, this is jammed out towards cover for one more.
Outside off, this is cut through point for one.

FOUR BYES! Bonus runs! Good start to the over! Henriques moves outside off and looks to sweep. This is fired outside off. He misses. Pooran is blind-sighted, he too lets it through and it goes to the third man fence.
A single now! On the pads, this is worked on the leg side for one.
Moises Henriques walks out to bat now!

OUT! TIMBER! After three average deliveries, Hayden Walsh manages to get a wicket! Bowls a short ball, on middle, this stays a little low. Josh Philippe rocks back and looks to cut but fails to connect any bat on it. The ball scampers through and hits the stump. So, West Indies gets the breakthrough and Australia are now 58 for 3.
Again a short ball, on middle. Pulled away to square leg for a single.
On middle, paddle sweeps it to mid-wicket .
FOUR! This time finds the gap! Another short ball, on middle. Marsh pulls it to square leg for four.
Good fielding in the deep by Sheldon Cottrell! Short ball, on middle. Marsh rocks back and pulls it to square leg where Cottrell dives to his right and does brilliantly to save couple of runs.

FOUR! Welcome boundary! 50 up for the Aussies! This is fired full and outside off, Josh goes after it, it goes off the outside edge and down to the third man fence. Australia need a lot more of these. 146 more needed in 13 overs.
Manages to sweep it, in the gap in the square leg region for two.
Just the one again! On middle, this is hit down to long on for one.
Outside off, this is cut through point for one.
On middle, this is pushed back to the bowler.
Plays the paddle sweep and drags it from wide outside off, towards deep backward square leg for one.
Allen comes onto bowl now!
On middle, flicked to mid-wicket for a single. 10 runs coming off the over. West Indies are 42 for 2 at the end of Powerplay.
Two taken! A full ball, slower, on middle. Eased down to long on for a couple of runs.
Another slower fuller ball, on middle. Josh Philippe flicks it to square leg for one.
Around off, punched off the back foot to sweper cover for a single.
FOUR! Edgy runs! Another slow ball, on a length, on middle. Marsh closes his bat face as he looks to flick, manages to get a thick outside edge, past the keeper and towards third man for four.
A low dipping full toss, on the pads, clipped to mid-wicket for a single.
Bravo to bowl the last over of the Powerplay!
Back of a length, on off. Josh Philippe hops and punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Good length ball, outside off, dabbed to third man for a single.
This time to the other side! On middle, eased down to mid on.
Full ball, on off. Marsh pushes it to mid off.
SIX! Welcome boundary! Mitchell Marsh continues his fine form! A short ball, outside off. Marsh slashes it over point for a biggie.
A length ball, outside off, chopped to the point fielder for a single.
Andre Russell is on now!
Bowls the one ball he had to nicely! On middle, it is worked towards mid-wicket for one.
Edwards has hurt himself! He is seen holding his shoulder! The physio is out. So Fidel is going off so someone has to finish the over. Simmons to do so.
On middle, kept out.
Another one of those dipping low full tos on the pads, it is worked on the leg side for one.
Just short! This is full and outside off, Marsh drives but straight to the man at covers.
Angled into the pads, Josh works it towards mid-wicket and takes one. He is off the mark.
WIDE! Tried the slower one again but this is well down the leg side. Wided.
Josh Philippe is the new man in!

OUT! TIMBER! Finch is completely done in by the dip on that slower one and that dropped chance has not cost a lot. Australia in deep, deep trouble now. This is a slower one, it is a full toss but just dips at the end as it gets to the batter. Finch looks to pull but misses it by a long way. It hits his pad and then onto the stumps. 178 more needed.
Another short of a length, on off. Punched to covers for a single. Another decent over from West Indies.
A back of a length ball, on middle. Marsh pulls it to square leg for one run.
SWING AND A MISS! A length ball, outside off. Marsh slashes but misses.
Length ball, on middle. Marsh blocks it out.
WIDE! Have to reload again! Tries to stay away from the batters arc but bowls it way over the tramline. Wided.
WIDE! Full ball, way outside off, over the tramline. Wided.
Around off, pushed to covers.

DROPPED! This might cost West Indies as they know how dangerous Aaron Finch can be! A back of a length ball, outside off. Finch cuts it straight to the point fielder where Andre Fletcher drops it. Single taken at the end. That was a simple chance! Is this the kind of luck Finch needed? He has been short of runs, can tonight be his night?
A good length ball, on middle, clipped to square leg for a single. Just 5 runs coming off this over. So, a good start from West Indies.
A length ball, outside off. Marsh drags it to mid on for one run.
Around off, pushed through covers for one.
A back of a length ball, angling on middle and leg. Finch leaves it alone in anticipation of a wide but not given.
Length ball, outside off. Finch slaps it to sweeper cover for a couple of runs.
SWING AND A MISS! A length ball, outside off, shapes away from the batter! Finch looks to slash at it but misses.
Fidel Edwards to bowl from the other end!
Length ball, on middle. Blocked out. So a wicket but 9 runs from the over.
FOUR! Good start from Mitchell Marsh! Overpitches it, on middle. Marsh carves it wide of mid on for a boundary.
A fullish length ball, on middle. Marsh squeezes it out in time.
WIDE! Spills it way down the leg side. Wided.

FOUR! Australia and Mitchell Marsh are off the mark! A full ball, around off. Marsh leans forward and drives it through covers for a boundary. He is greeted with a half volley which he gleefully puts away.
Mitchell Marsh comes out to bat!

OUT! CAUGHT! A perfect start from Sheldon Cottrell and Matthew Wade departs for a duck! A back of a length ball, outside off. Wade looks to pull it but doesn't time it well. Hits it towards mid on where Andre Russell dives to his right and takes a brilliant catch. A good wicket as Wade can be very dangerous once he gets his eye in.
Commentary.Howout: c Andre Russell b Sheldon Cottrell

Commentary.Commentary: Starts off with a length ball, on middle and off. Wade hops and looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
